source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes ordinary semi-Markovian ID completeness and uses binary countermodels for ordinary hedge/C-tree nonidentification, without selected-law normalization.
The paper proves a sound-and-complete c-gID algorithm under an explicit positivity requirement for combinations of observational/interventional Q[S] inputs.
The paper introduces SCM conditioning for latent selection and states preservation of causal-model structure plus commutation with marginalization; it is a forward conditioning construction.
The analysis uses a distinct gene-exposure group without neuroimaging and a non-overlapping gene-outcome group with HbA1c and neuroimaging for two-sample MR.

State a forest-incidence completeness theorem as the explicit fallback target, including a proved inclusion relation between its incidence class and the published augmented-ADMG class.
Make the failure certificate verifier an explicit finite input/output specification with response-table encoding length and a polynomial-time checking bound distinct from the search cost.
